def find_distinct_d(n, m, a, b):
    a_set = set(a)
    b_set = set(b)
    distinct_ds = set()

    for d in range(1, m + 1):
        c = [ai + d for ai in a]
        if all(bi in b_set for bi in c):
            distinct_ds.add(d)

    return len(distinct_ds)
